rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible blastocyst description and reasonable estimated Gardner range, but uses confident detail about ICM/TE quality and zona status that may exceed what can be reliably inferred from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, endometriosis, prior biochemical pregnancy, BMI, and semen data with prognosis in a clinically meaningful way, though some links are somewhat generalized.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with the implantation estimate tied to embryo morphology and patient factors; minor overinterpretation and speculative testing suggestions prevent a top score.

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-concordant, but ERA, NK/immunologic workup, routine PGT-A in a young patient, and broad adjunct suggestions are not strongly supported for routine use.
Gives clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, including SET and evaluation options, though some proposed interventions are more controversial than standard practice.
